purpose: Model submarine and major terrestrial telecom cables as physical connectivity, ownership, capacity, jurisdiction and resilience infrastructure.

entity.scope: publicly documented communications cables and landing infrastructure

evidence_model.rule: Use public infrastructure information only; do not infer sensitive operational details from speculation.

validation_rules: landing points must be distinguished from cable route
design capacity is not necessarily lit capacity
outage reports need date and source
ownership consortium and operator are distinct

implementation_notes.canonical_owner: Cable records own cable-level facts; landing stations and companies remain independent canonical nodes.
implementation_notes.frontend: Render route, endpoints, ownership, capacity and redundancy before visual maps.
known_traps: landing station ownership can differ from cable ownership
implementation_notes.research_task: Map European connectivity chokepoints and redundancy by country and landing region using public evidence.
